facts.evidence: Reported sales grew 6.6% to $25.3 billion in Q2 2026.
Adjusted EPS increased to $2.90, up 4.7% from the prior year.
Adjusted EPS guidance increased to $11.68, a 8.2% rise from the previous guidance.
Raised 2026 guidance for estimated reported sales to $101.1 billion, a 7.3% increase.
Free cash flow estimated at ~$8.7 billion, a significant increase from $6.2 billion in Q2 2025.

claims.claim: Reported sales grew 6.6% to $25.3 billion in Q2 2026.
Adjusted EPS increased to $2.90 in Q2 2026, up 4.7% from the prior year.
Free cash flow was estimated at ~$8.7 billion, a significant increase from $6.2 billion in Q2 2025.
claims.note: Wrong period/basis: the release presents ~$8,700M and $6,214M as second-quarter year-to-date figures (2026 estimated as of July 15, 2026), not as the three-month quarter; the $6,214M comparator is prior-year YTD, not Q2 2025.

claims.claim: Innovative Medicine growth was driven by strong performance in Oncology, Immunology and Neuroscience.
MedTech growth came from Surgery, Cardiovascular, Vision and Orthopaedics.
2026 guidance for estimated reported sales was raised to $101.1 billion, a 7.3% increase.
Adjusted EPS guidance was increased to $11.68.
The adjusted EPS guidance figure represents an 8.2% rise from the previous guidance.
claims.note: The release's 8.2% is growth versus prior year at the midpoint, not versus prior guidance; the increase from April guidance was $0.13 (from a $11.55 midpoint).

claims.claim: Free cash flow was estimated at ~$8.7 billion for year-to-date 2026.
No specific capital allocation or balance sheet details were provided in the release.
